title: The answer of verify-signed-data
description: What aprv.wasm's verify-signed-data export returns (aprv-wire): a verified JWS with its payload, or a failure. The payload is a JSON string holding the signed payload's JSON text exactly as signed, so no host re-serialises Apple's claims; its content is Apple's and not described here.

environment.description: The environment the payload names, as the core states it (DECISIONS.md R42): the first of the top-level environment, data.environment and summary.environment that is present decides; "Production" and "Sandbox" map, anything else, or none of the three, is null.

failure.description: A verification failure. Match on reason; message is safe to log, never embeds raw input, and is not meant to be parsed.
